comments.author: BIakeC
comments.body:
For those wondering about the new Rome church dungeon... Upper floor has mid level 60 NPCs and drops the following goods:

Velvet, Glasswork, Silverwork, Ceramics, Jewellery, Silverware, Bronze Sculpture, Stone Sculpture, Marble Sculpture, Copper Etchings, Antique Art, and Oil Paintings.

Haven't gotten to mid floors yet. Unlike other dungeons there's no quest to take to unlock the mid floor. Instead you have to make a glasswork discovery on floor 1. I haven't been able to do that yet.

comments.author: BIakeC
comments.body: Chests in upper floor can rarely drop these: Gold, Single-handed Swords, Fine Fur, Fine Velvet, and Headache Medication. Their a bit more common in the Hidden passage floors. You get the The Buried Glassware discovery there too to unlock Mid floor.

comments.author: BIakeC
comments.body: Middle floor has mid level 70 NPCs (significantly harder then the upper floor bad guys, especially on the last floor). And it drops these: Gold, Silver, Platinum, Diamond, Peridot, Glasswork, Goldwork, Silverwork, Embroidery Thread (!!), Gold Thread, Bronze Sculpture, Marble Sculpture, Antique Art, Oil Paintings, Stone, Silverware, and Jewellery. Can rarely drop Fine Velvet and Clay... Hidden floors are harder to get into then the ones on Upper so I might be missing a couple things.
